palette_hint: Start with a block. Make it yours.
canvas_hint: Drag to move · Corner to resize · Arrow keys to nudge
backend_notice: MVP inventory preview: Minecraft maps components to a 9×6 inventory. Images and styling are approximated. This canvas shows your design, not a pixel-perfect in-game result.
auth_hint: Run /wellui editor in Minecraft. Open the private link, or paste it below. Your design stays here while you reconnect.
ready: Make something that feels like your server. Select a layer to get started.
empty: Select a component on the canvas to edit it, or add one from the palette.
label: Label
command_hint: Runs as the clicking player, with their permissions. Leave out the leading slash.
delete_confirm: Delete this component and its children? You can undo this change.
discard_confirm: Discard unsaved changes and open another project?
inside_panel: New components will be added inside this selected panel.
new_created: Project created. Add components, then save your design.
validate_ok: Your design is valid and its images are available.
deploy_ok: Deployment completed. Open the project using /wellui open {id}.
upload_ok: Image uploaded. Select it to adjust its size and position.
error_network: Could not reach the editor. Check the server and your connection.
error_local: Please check the selected values and try again.
editor.deploy.export_only: Export complete. This standalone editor saves files and builds a pack; no Minecraft server is connected.
editor.error.session: Your session is missing or expired. Run /wellui editor for a fresh private link.
editor.error.not_found: This project or resource was not found.
editor.error.invalid: The submitted document or image is invalid. Check its fields and file type.
editor.error.internal: The server could not finish this operation. Check its log and try again.
editor.error.id_mismatch: The project identifier does not match the saved document.
editor.error.asset_in_use: This image is used by a saved project, deployed revision or retained backup.
editor.error.asset_missing: A referenced image is missing. Upload it again.
editor.error.too_large: The upload exceeds the server's size limit.
editor.error.content_type: Use a PNG file for images.
editor.error.origin: This editor address is not allowed. Open the exact link supplied by your server.
validation.schema: This document uses an unsupported schema.
validation.name: Give the project a name of at most 128 characters.

validation.depth: There are too many nested panels.
validation.component_limit: A project can contain up to 500 components.
validation.duplicate_id: Two components have the same identifier.
validation.layout: Check this component's position, dimensions and anchor.

validation.action: Choose an action and enter a valid value.

logic.schema: This logic graph uses an unsupported schema.

logic.placeholder: Enter a placeholder enclosed in percent signs.
logic.placeholder_unavailable: PlaceholderAPI is unavailable. Conditions return false; placeholder value paths stop safely.
logic.missing_node: A connection references a missing node.
logic.port: A connection references a missing port.
logic.type: Connect ports and values with matching types.

logic.unreachable: This node is not connected to an event.
logic.disconnected: This event has no connected behavior.
logic.budget: This event reached its limit of 128 execution steps.
logic.continuations: This session already has 8 delayed continuations.

logic.failed: Logic execution stopped safely after an error.
logic.depth: Value evaluation exceeded the depth limit.
logic.value_source: This node cannot provide a value.
logic.text_limit: Session text supports at most 2048 characters.
logic.hud_dynamic: HUD cannot display session visual changes. Use SCREEN within its limits or Inventory.
logic.screen_layers: Dynamic SCREEN projects support up to 16 components, including panels and their children.
logic.denied: The player lacks permission to open the destination.
logic.session_closed: This session has closed. Pending logic was cancelled.
logic.text_transport: The active packet transport cannot display dynamic text.
logic.invalid: The logic graph is invalid. Check its fields and connections.

logic.json: The logic graph JSON is malformed.
logic.project_in_use: Another saved or deployed project links to this interface.
logic.number: Numbers must be finite and have magnitude at most one trillion.
logic.boolean: Boolean values must be true or false.
animation.json: Animation fields, property, loop, end behavior or easing are invalid.

deploy.dependencies_limit: A deployment may include at most 64 linked projects.
control.form_value: Set individual field values; form validity is computed automatically.
control.options: Select requires 1–32 unique options with nonempty labels and values.

control.range: Check slider minimum, maximum and positive step.
